title: 嚴重過敏反應與緊急狀況：打 119
body: 新食物吃完後觀察有沒有長紅疹、腹瀉、嘔吐；有反應就先停，1 到 2 個月後再試。出現呼吸困難、嘴唇或舌頭腫、全身蕁麻疹、嘔吐合併嗜睡，或是抽搐、誤食藥品或清潔劑、叫不醒，立刻打 119。報案時說地址、孩子年齡、現在的意識與呼吸狀況。

sources.name: 衛生福利部國民健康署：嬰兒副食品添加
sources.excerpt: 每次只添加一種新食物，由少量（1-2湯匙）開始，逐漸增加，觀察3-5天，無長紅疹、腹瀉或嘔吐症狀時可繼續；有反應應暫停1-2個月後再試。

sources.name: NHS：Anaphylaxis
sources.excerpt: Anaphylaxis is a life-threatening allergic reaction that happens very quickly. It can be caused by food, medicine or insect stings. Symptoms of anaphylaxis happen very quickly. Immediate action required: Call 999 if: your lips, mouth, throat or tongue suddenly become swollen; you are breathing very fast or struggling to breathe (you may become very wheezy or feel like you are choking or gasping for air); your skin, tongue or lips turn blue, grey or pale. Call 999 for an ambulance and say that you think you are having an anaphylactic reaction.
